author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Privately spots Twitch unfollows by comparing two full follower checks before reporting anyone.
changelog: 4.1.7: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.7, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 3.5.0: repairs full-page Twitch pagination and adds an authenticated private history and scan-status panel to the local wizard. Also aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.5.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial release with silent baseline creation, paginated Twitch snapshots, two-scan removal confirmation, and fail-closed private history.

manifest.name: Follower Pulse
installationSteps: Import the Follower Pulse Streamer.bot package.
Keep Snapshot Page triggerless and approve only its action ID for Follower Pulse.
Reconnect the Twitch broadcaster in Streamer.bot if moderator:read:followers is unavailable, then enable Follower Pulse.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private follower history is kept until you delete it.

healthChecks.description: Checks that Twitch follower checks are scheduled and report nothing if a check is incomplete.
